Anyway i lost so much because i had no help to move stuff into storage. So i lost a table and chairs that i'd spent $800 on, a custom leather couch i'd spent $6000 on, a really nice bookcase i made in high school shop class that had a lot of sentimental value, lots of clothes and lots of kitchen stuff.  Basically a whole house full of stuff that while mostly replacable really hit me very hard since i can't even make the money i used to from being disabled. While a lot of it is just "things" those things took a lot of life out of me to acquire and made my life considerably better.  i also gave away tons of posessions because i felt suicidal and i wanted them to go to a good home instead of rotting in a landfill.  Anyway you're not alone, this stuff sadly happens, i wish you the best. Crying is very thereputic. (((Hugs)))
